verdict.rationale: Close documents tiered MCP access scopes (mcp.read read-only, mcp.write_safe read/write, mcp.write_destructive read/write/delete), so an AI agent connecting via the official MCP server can be held to least privilege. Beyond that, API keys and OAuth are documented with no scoping or permission limits shown, and the MCP scopes are only three coarse tiers. Missing for 10: scoped or per-resource permissions on API keys or OAuth tokens, finer-grained scopes than three access tiers, documentation of how scoped credentials are issued and revoked, independent corroboration.
